name: logisketch-diagram-eval
notes: Frozen test set. Do not edit to improve scores. requiredElements are names the prompt explicitly asks for; matching is case-insensitive and ignores spaces, underscores and punctuation. An array inside requiredElements means any one of the alternatives counts.

tests.prompt: Create an ER diagram for a library. Entities: book, author, member and loan. A book has one author, an author writes many books, a member has many loans, and each loan is for one book. Show primary and foreign keys.

ER diagram for a university: student, course, professor and enrollment. A student has many enrollments, a course has many enrollments, a professor teaches many courses. Include student_id and course_id keys.

Mermaid ER diagram for an online store with CUSTOMER, ORDER, ORDER_ITEM, PRODUCT and PAYMENT. A customer places many orders, an order contains many order items, each order item refers to one product, each order has one payment.

Entity relationship diagram for a clinic: PATIENT, DOCTOR, APPOINTMENT and PRESCRIPTION. A patient books many appointments, a doctor has many appointments, an appointment can produce many prescriptions. Add a few attributes per entity.
Database schema for a blog as an ER diagram with tables users, posts, comments and tags, plus a post_tags join table. Posts belong to users, comments belong to posts and users.
PlantUML ER diagram for hotel booking with entities guest, room, reservation and invoice. A guest makes many reservations, a reservation is for one room, each reservation has one invoice.
Flowchart for password reset: user requests reset, system sends email with token, check if token is valid, if valid user sets new password, otherwise show error.

ATM cash withdrawal flowchart: insert card, enter PIN, decide if PIN is valid, enter amount, decide if balance is sufficient, dispense cash, print receipt. Invalid PIN or low balance should end with an error message.
Order fulfillment flowchart in Graphviz: receive order, check inventory, decision in stock?, if yes pack and ship, if no create backorder and notify customer.
CI/CD flowchart: developer commits code, build, run unit tests, decision tests passed?, deploy to staging, manual approval, deploy to production. Failed tests notify the developer.
Loan approval flowchart: application submitted, credit check, decision credit score above 700?, approve if yes, manual review if no, manual review can approve or reject.
Support ticket triage flow as a block diagram: new ticket, classify, urgent?, escalate to on-call if urgent, else assign agent, then resolve and close ticket.
Sequence diagram of OAuth authorization code login between user, browser, auth server and resource server: login redirect, authorization code, exchange code for access token, call API with token.
Checkout sequence: customer submits order to shop, shop asks payment gateway to charge card, gateway asks bank for authorization, bank approves, shop sends receipt to customer.
PlantUML sequence for ride hailing: rider requests ride in app, app asks matching service, matching service offers ride to driver, driver accepts, app shows ETA to rider.

Sequence diagram for file upload: user uploads file to API, API stores it in storage, API asks virus scanner to scan it; if infected the file is deleted and user gets an error, if clean user gets a success message.

Mermaid sequence diagram for chat message delivery: sender sends message to chat server, server puts it on message queue, queue delivers to recipient, recipient sends read receipt back to sender via server.

Login with two-factor authentication: user enters password in web app, web app checks it with auth service, auth service sends OTP through SMS provider, user enters OTP, auth service verifies OTP and returns a session.
UML class diagram: abstract class Shape with area() and perimeter(); Circle, Rectangle and Triangle extend Shape; a Drawing contains many shapes.
UML state diagram for an order: Created, Paid, Shipped, Delivered and Cancelled. Created can be paid or cancelled, Paid can be shipped or cancelled, Shipped becomes Delivered.
Class diagram for a library system: Library has many Books, Member and Librarian both inherit from Person, a Member can borrow() and return() books.
UML class diagram with an interface PaymentMethod with pay(amount), implemented by CreditCardPayment and PayPalPayment. An Order uses one PaymentMethod.
Mermaid class diagram for banking: Account with balance, deposit() and withdraw(); SavingsAccount and CheckingAccount extend Account; a Customer owns many accounts.

State diagram for a media player with states Stopped, Playing, Paused and Buffering. Play moves Stopped to Playing, pause and resume switch between Playing and Paused, Playing can go to Buffering and back, stop returns to Stopped.

C4 container diagram for internet banking: customer uses a mobile app, the app calls an API gateway, the gateway calls an accounts service, the accounts service stores data in a database and sends notifications through an external email system.
C4 system context diagram for an e-learning platform used by students and instructors, which uses an external payment provider and an external video hosting service.
Structurizr container diagram for a food delivery platform: customer and courier people, the platform has a web app, an API and an orders database; the API uses an external maps service.

Structurizr diagram for an IoT monitoring system: devices send telemetry to an ingestion service, a stream processor reads it, writes to a time series database, and a dashboard shows it to an operator.

Microservices architecture diagram: clients go through an API gateway to auth service, user service and order service; order service publishes events to Kafka; user and order services use PostgreSQL; auth service uses Redis.

Three-tier web architecture: users hit a load balancer, which routes to two web servers, which call an app server; the app server uses a cache and a primary database that replicates to a read replica.
